chunks: My father (may God have mercy on him) and Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil and Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluwayh and Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim and Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamdani and al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Natana (may God be pleased with them) narrated to us. They said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us from his father Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Abu Hudba, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Tuba (eternal bliss) is for the one who has seen me. Tuba is for the one who has seen one who has seen me. Tuba is for the one who has seen one who has seen one who has seen me.

key_terms.رآني: Saw me — witnessing the Prophet in person, with the implication of faith and sincerity in that encounter
key_terms.طوبى: Tuba — a term denoting blessed felicity, paradisiacal joy, and good fortune. It is also the name of a tree in Paradise mentioned in Quran 13:29.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about those who saw him or those who saw his companions?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) announces three-tiered spiritual blessings (tuba) for those who saw him directly, those who saw his companions, and those who saw the companions' companions. This hadith, narrated through al-Saduq's chain going back through Anas ibn Malik, emphasizes the profound spiritual merit of proximity to the Prophet — even at two or three degrees of separation. The concept of 'tuba' here refers to a tree in Paradise as well as a general state of spiritual felicity.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him
